criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Same elevated oblique projection and ground-axis orientation.
Mountains, city, plants, river, and lower industry occupy matching frame positions.
different: No material yaw, pitch, elevation, or world-framing difference is visible.

evidence.observation: Oblique world view places mountains upper left, city upper right, and industry below.
The same projection, horizon placement, and landmark framing are retained.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Dense city mass remains upper right and industrial mass lower center.
The open central field and rugged western terrain retain the same occupancy balance.
different: Candidate resolves marginally sharper road and façade micro-detail without changing mass distribution.

evidence.observation: Compact city blocks fill the upper-right map sector.
City footprint and block concentration closely match the reference.
Large factory, roads, and substation form the lower industrial cluster.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Same S-curved channel descends from upper center toward the lower left.
Steep banks and the bridge attachment occur at matching locations.
different: Candidate water and banks are darker and crisper; reference water is slightly lighter and hazier.

evidence.observation: Light blue-gray river follows the central S-curve beneath the bridge.
Matching channel geometry is rendered with deeper shadows and stronger bank definition.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Site A and Site B plants have matching footprints and cooling-tower proportions.
Pylons, substation, factory, and city buildings preserve the same relative sizes.
different: Only minor silhouette crispness differs; no meaningful relative-scale shift is visible.

evidence.observation: Site A plant scale relative to nearby pylons and city is consistent.
Site A retains the same plant and cooling-tower proportions.
Site B footprint matches its mountain setting and transmission structures.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use soot-dark metal, weathered concrete and brown-gray terrain.
Amber illumination and restrained cyan accents share the same cohesive industrial palette.
different: Candidate has deeper blacks, warmer amber, and higher local contrast; reference is slightly flatter and grayer.

evidence.observation: Terrain and facilities carry a muted, hazy charcoal-brown finish.
The same materials appear darker and more contrast-defined.
Inspector uses riveted blackened metal with amber and cyan edging.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Amber double-circuit routes connect both plant sites toward the city.
Cyan conductors follow the same lower corridor through the substation.
Amber planned and cyan energized networks remain immediately distinguishable.
different: No material route, tower-attachment, or state-coding difference is visible.

evidence.observation: Amber towers and paired conductors form the two readable plant corridors.
Amber corridors, tower spacing, and attachments closely coincide.
Cyan network arcs through the lower substation and industrial area.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Same top status bar, left tool rail, and tall right inspector frame the map.
Inspector cards, totals, warnings, and action buttons retain matching hierarchy and proportions.
different: Roman and Hangul glyph shapes produce small local text-width differences while preserving legibility and hierarchy.

evidence.observation: Riveted top chrome contains centered resource, plant, and pause readouts.
Top chrome and readout hierarchy match with localized glyphs.
Two stacked comparison cards and two lower actions occupy the right inspector.
